 KRAFTON India and District Bring Alan Walker to BMIC 2026 in Mumbai
 By EVENTFAQS Bureau - October 27, 2026 
 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 KRAFTON India, in partnership with District, has announced that global electronic music artist Alan Walker will headline the BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA INTERNATIONAL CUP (BMIC) 2026. The event will take place from 30 October to 1 November at the Dome, SVP Indoor Stadium (NSCI), Mumbai. Tickets are available on District.
 Alan Walker’s performance will build on his association with BGMI, which began in 2024 when his track ‘Hero’ became part of the game through the ‘Be A Hero’ campaign. The song featured in the BGMI lobby and was part of in-game events. His appearance at BMIC 2026 will bring the collaboration to the live stage, connecting music with the game’s esports community.
 Commenting on his return, Alan Walker said , “India, I’m coming home! The love I’ve received from BGMI players since ‘Hero’ became part of the game has been incredible, and I’m excited to perform for this community in person. BMIC 2026 brings together two things I’m passionate about – gaming and music – and I can’t wait to be part of it. Bring your squad, and let’s make some noise.”
 Karan Pathak, Associate Director – Esports, KRAFTON India said , “When ‘Hero’ became part of the BGMI lobby, our community embraced it as its own anthem. Bringing Alan Walker to BMIC 2026 takes that association from the game to the live stage. BMIC is a platform for the best teams in Asia to compete at the highest level, and we look forward to welcoming fans to Mumbai for an unforgettable weekend.”
 BMIC 2026 will bring together 16 teams from India, South Korea and Japan for three days of competition. The line-up includes six teams from India, five from South Korea and five from Japan. The teams will compete for a ₹1 crore prize pool and qualification berths for the Global Championship 2026.
 India’s contingent will be led by BMSD 2026 champions iQOO SouL, alongside Gladiators Esports, iQOO 8Bit, K9 Esports, Blitz Epigrotive Gaming and Outrage Esports.
 The event will combine international esports competition with a live music performance, bringing gaming and music together for audiences in Mumbai. Fans can book their tickets for BMIC 2026 through District.
